slides.heading: REMBRANDT LIGHTING
slides.subheading: Aim for the signature triangle under the eye

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Rembrandt lighting creates a triangle of light under the eye
Works well for portraits and interviews

slides.heading: THE TRIANGLE
slides.caption: Key at 45° above eye level — nose shadow connects to cheek, leaving a lit triangle.

slides.heading: HOW TO SET IT UP
steps: Raise it slightly above eye level.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Use negative fill to deepen the shadow side.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Letting the triangle get too large or too bright.
